column1: # qed_alerts.tsv -- the structural alerts QED counts as its eighth input.
# Bickerton, Paolini, Besnard, Muresan, Hopkins, Nat. Chem. 2012, 4, 90.  The alert set QED weighs is
# Brenk, Schipani, James, Krasowski, Gilbert, Frearson, Wyatt, ChemMedChem 2008, 3, 435, which names
# WHAT THIS TABLE IS, AND WHAT IT IS NOT.  it holds the alerts chython STATES: 63 substructures, each
# written in chython SMARTS and each proved to fire by its own probe.  it is NOT the 116-row list, and
# `chython.chemistry.qed`'s ALERTS term is therefore THIS table's count.  a score from chython and a
# score from another implementation of QED are two numbers with the same name; neither is a reading of
# the other.  the count is ratcheted by an equality in test_qed_alerts_tsv.py, so adding a row is a
# two-file change and dropping one cannot pass unnoticed.
# `name` and `description` are chython's labels for the alerted substructure.  a published alert name
# is quoted only where the substructure is exactly what that name says.
# `probe` IS A SMILES AND A PUBLIC COMPOUND, never a SMARTS: the bracket-and-bond rules of the pattern
# column do not apply to it.  a test asserts every row matches its own probe, because an alert that
# matches nothing lowers no score and would go unnoticed for years.
# THE DIALECT, IN THREE RULES.  every bracket atom frees the charge (`*`) or states one -- an unstated
# charge is charge ZERO.  every bond is written out, since an absent token matches SINGLE only and
# `[C;*;z4][C;*;z4]` therefore matches no aromatic ring.  a ring or non-ring bond is `~;@` / `~;!@`.

column5: nitro in its pentavalent drawing; the charge-separated drawing is the next row and both are needed, since chython stores what the file said
nitro drawn with a formal charge pair
seven chained sp3 carbons.  hexane is one short and trips nothing in this table, which is what makes the alkane gate a real gate
quaternary ammonium.  the four carbons are what separate it from an amine oxide, whose nitrogen is also `[N;+;D4]`
ortho dihydroxy arene.  the two ring bonds are `:`; `-[C;*;z4][C;*;z4]-` would demand a single bond and match no catechol
an NH or NH2 on an aromatic carbon
ester whose alcohol half is aromatic
tertiary amine oxide.  THREE carbons are demanded because a bare `[N;+]-[O;-]` is also every charge-separated nitro group, which is row 2's alert and not this one
an S-N single bond anywhere; broader than the sulfonamide row above and published alongside it
nitrile conjugated to a double bond
chloride, bromide or iodide on an sp3 carbon.  fluorine is left out: a C-F bond is not the leaving group the alert is about
halogen alpha to an aromatic nitrogen
three consecutive carbons each carrying two or more fluorines
two arenes joined by a double bond
an enol ether outside a ring; the `!@` is the whole alert, since a ring enol ether is a different matter
nitrile and hydroxyl on the same carbon
cyclohexadienedione.  kekulized by construction: a quinone ring is not aromatic and `thiele()` leaves it alone
two ring amines on adjacent aromatic carbons
azine N-oxide.  `z4` is what keeps a nitro group out: an aryl nitro nitrogen is not itself aromatic
